about.subtitle: Back-end Software Engineer
paragraphs: I am a backend-focused software engineer with hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining reliable, scalable backend systems. I primarily work with Go, Python, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL to build clean, maintainable, and performance-oriented applications.

My work focuses on backend architecture, RESTful API development, and database-driven systems. I have experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, as well as NoSQL solutions like MongoDB, ensuring efficient data modeling, querying, and optimization.

I am familiar with various Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) tools, including GORM, Prisma, Sequelize, and SQLAlchemy, which help me write structured, maintainable code while maintaining strong control over database performance and data integrity.

In addition to backend development, I have hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, GitHub for version control and collaboration, and Postman for API testing and validation. These tools support my workflow in building, testing, and deploying backend services efficiently.

Beyond technical skills, I value clear communication, responsibility, and collaboration. I approach problem-solving with a structured and analytical mindset, breaking down complex requirements into manageable solutions aligned with business needs.

I am highly motivated to continuously improve my backend expertise and stay up to date with modern technologies, best practices, and system design principles to deliver sustainable, long-term software solutions.
